revenue.source: L'Oréal 2025 Annual Results press release (12 Feb 2026), Appendix 2 consolidated income statements, net sales

operating_income.source: L'Oréal 2025 Annual Results press release, Appendix 2, operating profit

d_and_a.source: stockanalysis.com L'Oréal cash flow statement (Depreciation & Amortization, EUR m) - third-party aggregator, not verified against filing; reviewer should check vs URD note on D&A incl. right-of-use

capex.source: L'Oréal 2025 Annual Results press release, Appendix 6 cash flow: purchases of property, plant and equipment and intangible assets

revenue_growth.source: Assumption: FY2025 like-for-like growth was +4.0% (reported +1.3% due to FX/scope); beauty market growing mid-single digit with L'Oréal outperforming; fade to 4% by end. FX assumed neutral.

ebit_margin.source: Assumption: FY2025 operating margin 20.2% (FY2024 20.0%, FY2023 19.8%); modest +10bp improvement held flat across projection

tax_rate.source: Assumption: approx. French statutory/group effective rate of ~25% on operating profit; not verified against filing

capex_pct_revenue.source: Assumption: FY2025 capex 1,495.3 = 3.4% of sales per L'Oréal press release; FY2023-25 range 3.6-3.8% -> use 3.4% as company-reported level

wacc.source: Assumption: low-beta (~0.8-0.9) defensive consumer staples, risk-free ~3%, ERP ~5.5%, minimal debt (AA/Aa1 rated) -> cost of equity ~7.5%

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: long-run nominal growth ~ inflation plus modest real growth, below WACC; brand-led category compounder

net_debt.source: L'Oréal Q4/FY2025 earnings call (12 Feb 2026): net debt EUR 254m excluding lease debt (EUR 2.05bn incl. leases per annual report key figures). Convention excludes leases.

diluted_shares.source: L'Oréal 2025 Annual Results press release: diluted average number of shares 535,366,634 (FY2025; prior year 536,078,431); expressed in millions
